fact: On 17 September 2023 the agriculture minister met ministry leaders on implementing an electronic census of cultivated areas from satellite images for wheat, clover, beet, maize, soybean, sunflower, rice and cotton, through a cooperation protocol with the National Authority for Remote Sensing.
title: «الزراعة»: حصر المحاصيل بالأقمار الصناعية يوفر البيانات لتحقيق الأمن الغذائي
